description: A hospital transport supervisor must assign the hospital's only wheelchair-accessible medical van for two same-day discharges and finalize the transport arrangements for the patient who will use another vehicle, with input from respiratory therapy and social work.

shared_context.S1: The hospital's only wheelchair-accessible medical van is available for one of two medically cleared discharges today: Patient A, who uses a wheelchair and is going to Maple Grove Assisted Living, or Patient B, who is going home.
shared_context.S2: Elena makes the final assignment of the medical van and records the transport plan.
shared_context.S3: Both patients are expected to leave the hospital today, and neither discharge transport plan has been finalized.
shared_context.S4: The daily discharge huddle includes respiratory therapy and social work before Elena closes the transport schedule.

PF1.text: Patient A's brother has an accessible SUV and confirmed to Rina by phone that he can pick Patient A up at 10:30 today; the 30-minute trip would arrive at Maple Grove by 11:00, within the facility's 10:00-12:00 arrival window.

PF2.text: Patient B must use supplemental oxygen at 2 L/min continuously during the 45-minute trip home, and the hospital medical van is the only available vehicle today with an approved oxygen-cylinder mount; Marcus verified the requirement during this morning's respiratory assessment.

acceptance_conditions: The medical van must be assigned to Patient B because Patient B requires continuous oxygen and the van is the only vehicle with an approved oxygen-cylinder mount.
The oxygen-cylinder mount must be checked and documented for Patient B's transport.
Patient A's accessible SUV transport must be recorded for a 10:30 pickup and 11:00 arrival at Maple Grove Assisted Living.
The transport plan must cite the respiratory finding requiring Patient B's oxygen-supported trip.

content_checks.C3: any(c['type'] == 'alternate_transport' and c['target'] == 'Patient A' and c['detail'] == 'Accessible SUV pickup at 10:30; arrival at Maple Grove Assisted Living at 11:00' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The brother's confirmed accessible SUV changes Patient A's plan from having no recorded alternative transport to a 10:30 pickup with an exact 11:00 Maple Grove arrival.

Patient B's exact 2 L/min continuous-oxygen requirement changes the van assignment from an unresolved choice to Patient B and changes the equipment check from unspecified to confirmation of the approved oxygen-cylinder mount.
